fontLicensePolicy: The existing renamed Source Sans 3 Regular instance is reused unchanged with source and OFL notice retained. The same static font, optical design and weight400 are used in both variants.
mode: Previously generated photographic sources and paper presentation reused unchanged; precise typography authored separately with fixed line breaks. No new image generation.

layout_record.method: Exact-font whole-word wrapping computed once and preserved in both variants. Only the declared baseline interval and consequent tspan y coordinates vary; first baseline fixed.

comparisonPolicy: Only the declared baseline interval and consequent line positions vary. Journal size22/leading23→33, six lines; care size22/leading48→33, four lines; poster title size52/leading91→58, two lines. First baseline, left anchor, every word/line break, font/size/weight, image bytes/crops, unrelated typography, paper and lighting remain fixed. Block heights necessarily change.

verification.textBounds: within the declared paper or phone surface
verification.pixelCheck: Only intended declared line-spacing intervention regions differ.

limitations: Static English-language illustrations; no reader study, measured performance improvement, physical print proof, implemented responsive behavior or full accessibility evaluation. Other purposes or individual reader preferences may favor the before settings.
